sources.inspected: briefs/issue-5.json, live snapshot retrieved by coordinator 2026-11-12, zero comments

sources.limitations: No full F(Y,Q), added-operator definition, complete initial state or stress/entropy diagnostic is specified.

sources.title: New Relativistic Theory for Modified Newtonian Dynamics
sources.classification: conditional field theory; published linear equations
sources.inspected: Full HTML saved locally; equations 7-12 and adjacent cosmological discussion inspected directly
sources.supports: Definitions of delta, theta, gamma, chi and E; pressure nonclosure; evolution of E; metric density/momentum sources and unchanged shear equation. The chosen full function and background parameters remain necessary.
sources.limitations: No nonlinear collapse or entropy law. The compensated pair is our algebraic consequence and awaits a complete canonical initial-data implementation.

sources.title: Aether scalar tensor theory: Hamiltonian Formalism
sources.authors: Marianthi Bataki, Constantinos Skordis and Tom Zlosnik
sources.classification: conditional field theory; Hamiltonian and constraint analysis
sources.inspected: Full HTML saved; equations 1-4, section V.4 equations 62-63, sections VI-VII; peer review independently checked the auxiliary-constraint step
sources.supports: Exact reference action, six physical degrees of freedom, constraints and auxiliary-variable relations. Higher-derivative additions require a new canonical analysis.
sources.limitations: The Hamiltonian analysis is for the displayed action. It is not a ready validated collapse integrator, and does not validate an unspecified scordatura extension.

sources.title: Dynamics of Gravity in a Higgs Phase
sources.authors: Nima Arkani-Hamed, Hsin-Chia Cheng, Markus A. Luty, Shinji Mukohyama and Toby Wiseman
sources.classification: conditional ghost-condensate result and numerical study
sources.inspected: Primary PDF downloaded and text extracted; sections 3.1, 3.3, 3.5, especially equations 3.5-3.6 and 3.36-3.44; original page numbers 13 and 19-21
sources.supports: Perfect planar caustic has pi_xxxx=0 despite divergent pi_xx. A leading spatial higher derivative is not a universal caustic cure.
sources.limitations: A local, special solution of a nonrelativistic truncation. It has unsuitable global boundary/energy behavior for an isolated halo. It is not an AeST no-go or a proof that every ultraviolet completion fails.

sources.title: Weakly-coupled stealth solution in scordatura degenerate theory
sources.inspected: Primary HTML saved; section III equations 36-37 and 53-54, cutoff and apparent high-energy branch discussion
sources.supports: Controlled detuning can restore k^4 dispersion in the analyzed scalar-tensor setup while an apparent extra branch lies outside its low-energy regime.
sources.limitations: The result assumes the specified theory and background. It does not establish admissibility of a new operator in AeST or control through arbitrary caustics.

sources.title: Dissipative shock waves generated by a quantum-mechanical piston
sources.authors: Maren E. Mossman, Mark A. Hoefer, Keith Julien, Panos G. Kevrekidis and Peter Engels
sources.classification: measured condensate precedent plus conditional coarse interpretation
sources.inspected: Primary arXiv HTML sections I.1-I.3, discussion and Methods; publication text also retrieved in search
sources.supports: Driven three-dimensional condensate experiment and conservative GP simulations agree. Transverse soliton instability and vortex excitations accompany coarse dissipative-like shocks.
sources.limitations: Externally driven, trapped complex condensate; not AeST or an undriven halo. Eddy viscosity is an interpretation. Full GPE simulation uses measured inputs without fitting, whereas coarse viscous comparison includes fitted effective sound speed, filtering and profile parameters. It does not prove full thermalization.

sources.title: On Dispersive and Classical Shock Waves in Bose-Einstein Condensates and Gas Dynamics
sources.authors: M. A. Hoefer, M. J. Ablowitz, I. Coddington, E. A. Cornell, P. Engels and V. Schweikhard
sources.classification: measured condensate precedent and dispersive model
sources.inspected: Primary arXiv abstract and APS publication abstract
sources.supports: Conservative GP dynamics supports dispersive shocks with structure and front speed distinct from classical dissipative shocks.
sources.limitations: Only narrow abstract-level claim used. No AeST extrapolation.

sources.title: Compensated scalar/vector velocity pair in published linear AeST variables
sources.classification: our algebraic inference, independently checked by expedition peers
sources.supports: At a regular nonzero-k mode, equal delta/theta can coexist algebraically with different Pi and theta_dot. Direct theta differentiation and Eq12 agree.
sources.limitations: No full canonical map, restricted-initial-ensemble study, nonlinear evolution or instability analysis performed. Auxiliaries must change consistently. Dustlike limit can suppress the witness and needs nonsingular variables.

sources.title: Matched low-order velocity moments with different exact free-streaming responses
sources.supports: Counterstreams and Gaussian share initial density, mean velocity and pressure but have different fourth moments and mode responses.
sources.limitations: No gravity or collisions. A diagnostic counterexample to inferring a complete constitutive law from pressure alone, not a model of AeST or thermal gas.

sources.title: Persistence, hidden dynamics, scale selection and robustness expedition reports

sources.limitations: The inherited scale calculations were not rerun in this pass. They are same-expedition evidence, not independent observational confirmation.
